items.name: checks
items.doc: Collection of SlintScanners static analysis checks — tokens, strings, structure, events, mother-child, and architecture.

items.name: scan_project
items.doc:
Scan all `.slint` files and emit `cargo:warning` for each violation.
Call this from `build.rs`.

Returns the total number of errors found.

items.name: scan_file
items.doc: Scan a single `.slint` file and return all issues.
